summary: Turns synchronized mono speech, sound effects, and background music on or off. It changes the delivered media, not reference-audio input; disabling it produces a silent output even when the prompt describes sound.
combines: Dialogue placed in double quotes inside the prompt improves the generated speech.
2.5 additionally accepts audio-only input; the 2.0 series requires at least one reference image or video.

usage.from: state.videoGenerationConfig.generateAudio, validated from the Generate audio toggle
usage.what: Sends the per-model audio choice, defaulting to BytePlus's documented true value.
